chapters.label: Montjuïc, live
chapters.text: Barcelona, in blue and red, face Bayern Munich. Casadó, trapped deep, hits a long diagonal. Raphinha runs free on the left. Space in front! He drives at the box and shoots early. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. No defender is close yet. He doesn't wait. He curls it beyond Neuer.

chapters.label: Into the corner
chapters.text: From behind: it bends away from Neuer, into the corner! Raphinha scored three that night.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when you have space, shoot early, before the defender closes you down.
